status.scope_reason: The company provides digital technology solutions and SaaS cloud platforms specifically for supply chain and cross-border trade finance processing.
status.evidence: Linklogis released its 2026 interim financial results in August 2026, reporting revenue of RMB 579 million from its supply chain and industrial finance technology solutions.

claims.claim: In its 2026 interim financial reports, the company reported broadening its digital trade finance offerings into letters of credit and non-recourse financing as part of its cross-border international business suite.
claims.note: letters of credit and non-recourse financing
claims.source: Linklogis Inc. 2026 Interim Report

claims.claim: Linklogis Inc. officially launched the "BeeFeather AI Document Check Platform" in December 2024, using large language model technologies to parse and automate document review workflows in supply chain finance.
claims.source: Nasdaq / Press Release (December 30, 2024)

claims.claim: Linklogis is integrated into the TradeTrust network as a TradeTrust-Ready Partner, providing supply chain financing SaaS services to financial institutions and anchor buyers to enable interoperability of digital trade documents.
claims.source: TradeTrust Official Registry

claims.claim: Linklogis announced a strategic partnership with XRP Ledger in August 2025 to deploy its global digital supply chain finance application onto the XRPL mainnet to facilitate cross-border settlement and the tokenization of trade flows.
claims.source: Media OutReach Newswire (August 25, 2025)

claims.claim: Linklogis reports that its technology solutions processed a total supply chain asset transaction volume of RMB 508.1 billion during the 2025 calendar year, up 27% year-on-year.
claims.source: Linklogis 2025 Annual Results Announcement

claims.claim: The company reports the development and commercialization of its "BeeLink AI Agent" product matrix and the BeeFeather Platform in 2024 and 2025, integrating large language models with supply chain scenario knowledge graphs to handle tasks such as intelligent trade document checking and KYC for 42 financial institutions and industry customers.
claims.source: Linklogis Press Release (December 30, 2024 via GlobeNewswire / VIR Vietnam)

claims.claim: The company reports that its total revenue and income for the full year of 2025 was RMB 983 million, representing a slight decrease from the RMB 1.03 billion reported in fiscal year 2024.
claims.source: Linklogis 2025 Annual Results (Media OutReach Newswire) and 2024 Annual Results

claims.claim: The company reports that its revenue and income for the first half of 2026 reached RMB 579 million, representing a 55% year-on-year increase compared to the first half of 2025.
claims.source: Linklogis 2026 Interim Results Announcement (LinkedIn Official / Zhitong Finance / Moomoo)

claims.claim: The company reports that its international service network spans across Greater China, Southeast Asia, India, Europe, and North America, serving a total of 42 countries worldwide.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its international service network spans across Greater China, Southeast Asia, India, Europe, and North America, serving a total of 27 countries worldwide.
claims.source: Linklogis Official Website (About Us) states 27 countries and regions as of the end of 2025.

claims.claim: Linklogis Inc. completed an initial public offering on the main board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in April 2021, raising approximately USD 1.02 billion.
claims.source: Reuters / Bloomberg report on Linklogis Hong Kong IPO debut in April 2021

claims.claim: The company reports that the total volume of supply chain assets processed by its technology solutions reached RMB 508.1 billion in 2025, serving 3,145 anchor enterprises and cumulatively over 430,000 small and medium-sized enterprises.
claims.source: Linklogis 2025 Annual Results Press Release (Media OutReach)

claims.claim: The company reports that the total number of platform customers for its international cross-border trade business, rebranded as Unloq, reached 1,550 by the end of 2025.
claims.source: Linklogis 2025 Annual Results Press Release (Media OutReach)

status.scope_reason: The company operates a digital marketplace platform that connects corporate buyers, suppliers, and financiers to facilitate supply-chain and receivables financing.
status.evidence: Fiducia Data Services Limited provides an electronic platform to automate and facilitate supply chain financing and invoice factoring, according to its official terms and conditions.

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform has facilitated more than ₦1 trillion in discounted invoices, which includes ₦25 billion in transactions processed with microfinance banks and finance houses during the first half of 2026.
claims.source: Fiducia Corporate Website (myfiducia.com) & Instagram (@myfiduciahq)

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform operations recovery strategy targets a 5-hour business resumption window following a disruption. Instagram ·myfiduciahq +2
claims.note: business resumption window / recovery strategy timeline
claims.source: Fiducia Corporate Website and Media Records

claims.claim: Fiducia Data Services Limited expanded its strategic partnership with Mynd Fintech in December 2024 to extend its digital supply chain financing platform into new markets across Africa and the Caribbean by 2025.
claims.corrected: Fiducia Data Services Limited expanded its strategic partnership with Mynd Fintech in December 2024 to extend its digital supply chain financing platform into new markets across Africa and the Caribbean by 2025.
claims.note: The original claim is correct; however, the request instructs that if any part contradicts or matches perfectly without issue, we return the precise formatting. Checking official press releases shows this partnership was expanded in November/December 2024 for 2025.
claims.source: M1xchange & Fiducia Press Releases (myfiducia.com, m1xchange.com)

claims.claim: The company demonstrated its core digital marketplace backend infrastructure in June 2026, highlighting platform-generated legal assignment frameworks and automated risk mitigation protocols.
claims.note: demonstration of backend infrastructure in June 2026
claims.source: Fiducia Corporate Communications

claims.claim: Fiducia Data Services Limited has onboarded 110+ large corporates—including prominent entities like Olam, 7UP, ShopRite, and Access Bank—as participants onto its digital supply chain finance marketplace.
claims.source: Business Insider Africa & PM Express News Reports on Fiducia's Footprint

claims.claim: The company reports a strategic vendor and supplier early payment program partnership with major telecommunications operator MTN Nigeria to strengthen supplier ecosystems and access to finance.
claims.source: TechCabal and BusinessDay media reports on the Fiducia and MTN Nigeria strategic partnership announcement.

claims.claim: The company reports that its digital supply chain financing platform has facilitated over ₦1 trillion in total transaction throughput and discounted invoices, generating more than ₦3 billion in cumulative revenue since its launch.
claims.source: Official professional disclosures by Fiducia's leadership (Head of Enterprise Sales / Acting CEO) detailing over ₦1 trillion in transaction throughput and circa ₦4 billion in revenue.

claims.claim: The company reports that it processed ₦25 billion in transactions through its network specifically with microfinance banks and finance houses during the first half of 2026.
claims.source: Fiducia Data Services official H1 2026 performance milestone statements published on its verified social media platforms.

claims.claim: The company reports a strategic fintech partnership targeted for regional trade and supply chain financing expansion across Africa and the Caribbean markets.
claims.source: Official press release from M1xchange and Mynd Fintech announcing the regional expansion partnership into Africa and the Caribbean with Fiducia.

claims.claim: The company reports it has onboarded more than 110 large corporate entities, including Olam, 7UP, ShopRite, and Access Bank, onto its digital marketplace since launching in June 2023.
claims.source: Business Insider Africa report on Fiducia’s supply chain finance marketplace ecosystem footprint and corporate onboarding milestones.

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform financed over N15 billion in invoices during the fourth quarter of 2023.
claims.source: Business Insider Africa, PM Express
